title: c15's outside-slow ringless twin replicates on fresh seeds 12 and 13 with its own world: 16 and 11 persistent splits (gen 3/4) vs the ringed world's 16 and 10 (gen 3/3), at lower interior fuel (0.44 vs 0.56-0.64)
summary: Ran the finding's world.py unchanged with chi_s=0 and dout=0.1 (fuel diffusivity Df (h + 0.1 (1 - h)), h = (1+phi)/2) on fresh seeds 12 and 13, 128^2, T=1000. Outside-slow twin: 16 and 11 persistent splits, generation 3 and 4, 25 and 22 final bodies, 0% ringed, interior fuel 0.442 and 0.438. Ringed world on the same seeds (my earlier runs, 20261025T1500-c17-review-fuelcell and 20261025T1547-c17-review-fuelring-slowd): 16 and 10, generation 3 and 3, interior fuel 0.56 and 0.64. Ring off (chi_s=0, Df=2) on seed 12: 10, generation 2, fuel 0.35. The twin recovers the ring's whole division gain at lower interior fuel, as on the finding's seeds 0 and 2. My smooth-step version of the same control (20261025T1728-c17-review-fuelcell-slowd-twins: tanh(phi/0.2), Df_out 0.2) gave 14 and 17 on these seeds.

observations.finding: ringstat.txt: outside-slow twin 16/11 persistent splits, gen 3/4, interior fuel 0.44, 0% ringed; ringed world on the same seeds 16/10, gen 3/3, fuel 0.56/0.64; ring off 10 (seed 12)

verdicts.limitation: Two seeds. The ringed comparison comes from my earlier directories, not from re-runs here. Split counts vary by +-40% between seeds, so 'equal' means within that noise.
